name: popsicle
headline: MultiPost-Extension - Automate Social Media
short_description: MultiPost-Extension is a browser extension that automates content distribution across multiple social media platforms. It benefits marketing teams by reducing manual effort and ensuring consistent content delivery. It connects to popular social media platforms and integrates with content management systems.
author: leaperone

sections.overview:
MultiPost-Extension is a browser extension designed to streamline social media marketing by automating content distribution across multiple platforms simultaneously. The extension integrates with popular social media platforms and content management systems, eliminating the need for manual cross-posting on each channel. Marketing teams benefit from reduced manual effort and assured consistency in content delivery timing and messaging. The tool supports multi-language interfaces and includes features like auto-close publish pages with adjustable delay settings for enhanced workflow efficiency. Version 1.3.8 represents the latest stable release with ongoing development and community support.
Publish a blog post simultaneously to Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn with one click.
Share promotional images and videos across multiple platforms without needing to log in each time.
Automate the posting of content updates for a marketing campaign across various social media sites.
Quickly distribute event announcements to all relevant social media channels at once.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/leaperone/MultiPost-Extension`
sections.usage:
```
Use the MultiPost-Extension to schedule and distribute a new blog post titled '[BLOG_POST_TITLE]' to the following platforms: [PLATFORM_LIST, e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram]. Include the post text: '[POST_TEXT]' and the URL: [BLOG_POST_URL]. Optimize the post for each platform by adjusting the caption length and adding relevant hashtags. Schedule the posts to go live at [PREFERRED_TIMES, e.g., 9 AM and 3 PM EST]. Include a call-to-action to drive traffic to the blog post.
```
Copy

```
Here’s the optimized and scheduled content distribution for your blog post titled *"The Ultimate Guide to AI-Powered Marketing in 2024"* across LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram:

**LinkedIn (9:00 AM EST):**
*"🚀 The future of marketing is here! Check out our latest guide on AI-powered strategies to boost engagement and ROI. 📈

🔗 Read the full post: [https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide](https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide)

#AIinMarketing #DigitalMarketing #ContentStrategy #MarketingTips"

**Twitter (9:00 AM EST):**
*"AI is transforming marketing—here’s how to leverage it for better results. 📊

🔗 Full guide: [https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide](https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide)

#AI #Marketing #ContentMarketing #TechTrends"

**Facebook (3:00 PM EST):**
*"Did you know AI can help you create more engaging content? 🤖

Our new guide breaks down the best AI-powered marketing strategies to try in 2024. Click the link to learn more!

🔗 [https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide](https://blog.example.com/ai-marketing-guide)

#MarketingTips #AI #ContentCreation #SocialMediaMarketing"

**Instagram (3:00 PM EST):**
*Caption:* "AI isn’t just for tech giants—it’s for marketers too! 🌟 Swipe up to read our guide on using AI to supercharge your campaigns. 📲

*Hashtags:* #AIinMarketing #DigitalMarketing #ContentStrategy #Marketing2024

*Image/Video:* A carousel post with 3 slides: Slide 1 (AI stats), Slide 2 (key takeaways), Slide 3 (CTA with blog link).

All posts are scheduled and ready to publish. The extension will track engagement and provide analytics for each platform within 24 hours.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
